cards.name: Shining Brigade - Melody Division

effects.printed_clause: During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon/Set 1 "Shining Brigade" monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (You can only gain this effect once per turn).
effects.lua_implementation: A field EFFECT_EXTRA_SUMMON_COUNT targets 0x7a34 cards in hand/field with value 1; the engine’s shared extra-Summon count enforces gain once.

official_references.official_effect_text: During your [b]Main Phase[/b], [b]you can[/b] Normal Summon 1 Beast-Warrior monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. ([b]You can[/b] only gain this effect [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].) All Beast-Warrior monsters you control gain 100 ATK.

effects.printed_clause: During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon/Set 1 "Shining Brigade" monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set (You can only gain this effect once per turn). You can banish this card from your GY: Attach 1 "Shining Brigade" monster from your Deck or GY to a "Shining Brigade" Xyz Monster you control as material. You can only use this effect of "Shining Brigade - Melody Division" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A GY Ignition Effect with aux.bfgcost and hard code {id,1} chooses a face-up controlled 0x7a34 Xyz at resolution, then overlays one archetype monster from Deck/GY.

official_references.official_effect_text: If this card is sent to the GY: [b]Banish[/b] 1 Level 7 or higher LIGHT or DARK Dragon monster from your Deck. If this card is banished from your GY: [b]You can[/b] add the monster banished by this card's effect to your hand.

If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 "Zoodiac" monster in your GY, except "Zoodiac Ramram"; Special Summon it. An Xyz Monster whose original Type is Beast-Warrior [b]and[/b] has this card as material gains this effect.
● [b]When[/b] your opponent activates a Trap Card or effect that targets this card ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] detach 1 material from this card; [b]negate[/b] the activation.

cards.review_note: Independently reconciled against full printed text, canonical Lua, and the cited individual official Omega scripts/database rows.

coverage_override.reason: The additional Normal Summon permission and the GY banish/material-attachment effect with its HOPT are the two printed effects.
